title: cfs hero
description: A full-window photo hero: a large light grotesk statement low on the left, and below it up to three short pillars (an orange dot, a monospace label, a small paragraph) on a four-column grid; the first dot is filled and pulses. The content fades in on load; as the hero scrolls away the photo slowly grows (to 105%) and the pillars fade out.
notes: sized by the window (100svh); the media slot covers it like object-fit: cover
a `dark` subtree: white type over the photo; leaves room at the top for cfs-header in overlay mode
the scroll effects use CSS scroll timelines and are skipped where unsupported or with reduced motion
